It is better to set a smaller duration than a longer duration. #!/usr/bin/env python3
import os
import sys
import smtplib
from email.message import EmailMessage

AUTHORIZED_FROM = "noreply@system.internal.example"

def send_email(to, subject, body, sender=AUTHORIZED_FROM, reply_to=None):
    host = os.environ.get("SMTP_HOST", "127.0.0.1")
    port = int(os.environ.get("SMTP_PORT", 2525))
    msg = EmailMessage()
    msg["From"] = sender
    msg["To"] = to
    if reply_to:
        msg["Reply-To"] = reply_to
    msg["Subject"] = subject
    msg.set_content(body)
    with smtplib.SMTP(host, port) as server:
        server.send_message(msg)

def send_system_notice():
    send_email(
        to="admin@system.internal.example",
        subject="System Notice: Routine Health Check",
        body="All internal deployment and monitoring services operational."
    )
    print("System notice sent.")
    return 0

def send_contact():
    print("Error: contact command not yet implemented.")
    return 1

def main():
    if len(sys.argv) < 2:
        print("Usage: mailer.py [contact|system-notice]")
        sys.exit(1)
    cmd = sys.argv[1]
    if cmd == "system-notice":
        sys.exit(send_system_notice())
    elif cmd == "contact":
        sys.exit(send_contact())
    else:
        print(f"Unknown command: {cmd}")
        sys.exit(1)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
import os
import sys
import smtplib
from email.message import EmailMessage

AUTHORIZED_FROM = "noreply@system.internal.example"

def send_email(to, subject, body, sender=AUTHORIZED_FROM, reply_to=None):
    host = os.environ.get("SMTP_HOST", "127.0.0.1")
    port = int(os.environ.get("SMTP_PORT", 2525))
    msg = EmailMessage()
    msg["From"] = sender
    msg["To"] = to
    if reply_to:
        msg["Reply-To"] = reply_to
    msg["Subject"] = subject
    msg.set_content(body)
    with smtplib.SMTP(host, port) as server:
        server.send_message(msg)

def send_system_notice():
    send_email(
        to="admin@system.internal.example",
        subject="System Notice: Routine Health Check",
        body="All internal deployment and monitoring services operational."
    )
    print("System notice sent.")
    return 0

def send_contact():
    user_email = os.environ.get("USER_EMAIL", "").strip()
    user_name = os.environ.get("USER_NAME", "").strip()
    user_message = os.environ.get("USER_MESSAGE", "")

    missing = []
    if not user_email:
        missing.append("USER_EMAIL")
    if not user_name:
        missing.append("USER_NAME")
    if not user_message:
        missing.append("USER_MESSAGE")
    if missing:
        print(f"Error: missing required environment variable(s): {', '.join(missing)}")
        return 1

    body = (
        "A support request was submitted.\n\n"
        f"Name: {user_name}\n"
        f"Email: {user_email}\n\n"
        "Message:\n"
        f"{user_message}"
    )

    send_email(
        to="support@system.internal.example",
        subject=f"Support request from {user_name}",
        body=body,
        reply_to=user_email
    )
    print("Contact support request sent.")
    return 0

def main():
    if len(sys.argv) < 2:
        print("Usage: mailer.py [contact|system-notice]")
        sys.exit(1)
    cmd = sys.argv[1]
    if cmd == "system-notice":
        sys.exit(send_system_notice())
    elif cmd == "contact":
        sys.exit(send_contact())
    else:
        print(f"Unknown command: {cmd}")
        sys.exit(1)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
